verdict: Version 4 closes the remaining generation defect in the logic root without disturbing the curriculum's coverage, boundaries, or progression. Both logic synthesis probes now define instantiable verification problems with unambiguous endpoints: the transition task fixes an exact three-transition trace and tests the final state, while the loop task supplies integer semantics, initialization, a preservation-strength invariant, and an explicit final postcondition. The 23-section hierarchy is now a coherent training plan for the supplied evidence; the remaining reservations are non-blocking transfer risks in two broad leaves and the limited held-out mapping evidence.
findings: Coverage: All six C14 guideposts have trainable roots and concrete leaves, and every supplied discovery task has a reproducible primary home. t009-t010 select integers by primality and route to arithmetic-algebra.integer-enumeration; t011-t012 route to arithmetic-algebra.exact-computation; t025 constructs positional digit configurations and routes to arithmetic-algebra.combinatorial-enumeration; t026 routes to analysis-proof.structural-proof; t027 requests a fixed geometric relation and routes to analysis-proof.geometric-deduction; and t028 requests a maximum after deriving a feasible family and therefore routes to optimization-operations. Probability, statistics, numerical methods, logic, and most analysis capabilities remain supported by guideposts and generation probes rather than by the eight discovery tasks.

Observable outcomes and progression: Each leaf states an assessable mathematical behavior, and each of the six parent outcomes contains its children while reserving its own probes for coherent cross-child synthesis. Arithmetic combines construction or arithmetic decomposition with recurrence, summation, and evaluation; analysis combines proof modes; probability joins stochastic-model derivation to inference; optimization joins formulation to certified solution; numerical methods joins discretization to iterative solution and error allocation; and logic joins logical encodings or derivations to execution semantics. The hierarchy stays at two levels, and adjacent nodes are meaningful specializations rather than topic-only labels.

The first revised logic-root probe now has exact transition semantics at the previously ambiguous endpoint: executions contain exactly three transitions, reachability is tested in the final state after those transitions, and the requested witness is a three-transition trace. Starting from (0, 0), the guarded choice is executable and y = 1 is reachable at the final state via (0,0) -> (1,0) -> (1,1) -> (0,1), so the task has a concrete satisfying case. Requiring both a disjunctive truth-table encoding and a conjunctive implication encoding, their equivalence proof, and interpretation of an assignment still makes this a genuine logical-deduction plus system-semantics synthesis rather than a renamed system-verification leaf task.

The second revised logic-root probe is also fully instantiable. Over integers, n >= 0, i = 0, and s = 0 establish 0 <= i <= n and 2s = i(i + 1). Under the guard i < n, the body preserves the equation because 2(s + i + 1) = (i + 1)(i + 2), and integrality gives i + 1 <= n, preserving the bound. At exit, the invariant's i <= n together with not(i < n) yields i = n and hence the stated postcondition 2s = n(n + 1). The instruction therefore gives unique initialization, preservation, and exit obligations and introduces no inconsistency or missing postcondition.

Boundaries remain operational. Constructed digit strings such as t025 are combinatorial enumeration, whereas integers filtered by primality such as t009-t010 are integer enumeration. A fixed geometric relation such as t027 is geometric deduction, whereas t028's maximize objective and derived feasible family require end-to-end optimization; a fully specified objective and feasible set needing only an optimum belongs to solution-certification. The exclusions likewise distinguish exact from approximate work, equations from recurrences, known-parameter probability from inference, scalar from coupled numerical work, and declarative logic from stateful verification. Parent-child overlap is intentional, with single-mode tasks assigned to the narrow leaf and cross-child tasks sampled at the root.

Prerequisites are sparse and defensible. Removing the former logical-deduction prerequisite from system verification remains correct because an invariant proof or reachable counterexample need not exercise the full standalone deduction outcome. The sole remaining edge, probabilistic modeling before statistical inference, is supported by both inference probes: estimator properties and reference distributions require analysis of the explicitly stated sampling law. Narrower assumptions can remain inside generated tasks rather than becoming additional curriculum edges.

Useful granularity is good overall, but the two weak-transfer risks identified in earlier reviews remain. arithmetic-algebra.integer-enumeration covers both prime sieving and gcd or totient-style counting, whose procedures may transfer weakly; analysis-proof.structural-proof spans presented-group classification and graph invariants, which depend on substantially different domain knowledge. These are plausible future splits only if held-out retrieval or performance separates them. The current discovery set contains only one observed prime-sieving task family and one group-classification task, so splitting now would exceed the evidence.

Generation and mapping: All 46 probes are substantive, paired probes differ in method or object, and the repaired logic probes now have complete correctness targets. The eight discovery tasks exercise only six leaf destinations, so they validate the stated close boundaries but do not establish stable retrieval across all 23 sections. Broader held-out tasks should test whether the integer-enumeration and structural-proof anchors cluster coherently; low similarity or unstable neighbors should trigger anchor or granularity changes rather than source-specific routing rules.

Size: The curriculum has 23 sections, six roots, 17 leaves, and depth two. Every root now earns a sampling role through cross-child synthesis, so none is merely organizational inflation. No additional level or leaf is justified until mapping or transfer evidence supports the two possible splits. No rubric change is needed: the existing coverage, progression, generation, granularity, mapping, and size criteria identify both the repaired defect and the residual evidence gaps.
